dct_creator_sm: Global Water Futures, University of Waterloo.
dct_description_sm: The aim of this research is to quantify the dam-driven changes to coastal N:P:Si ratios delivered to coastal zones for river systems worldwide, and how these are changing over time.  Funding for this work was provided by the   Natural Science and Engineering Research Council of Canada (PDF-516575-2018) and Canada Excellence Research Chair in Ecohydrology. Note, that this data set will also be used to support research objectives in the Global Water Futures Project.
dct_title_s: Global dam-driven changes to riverine N:P:Si ratios delivered to the coastal ocean
